resources.string: Bike Rotation Lock needs permission to modify Android\'s rotation settings. No personal information is accessed or collected.
It is used only to turn off automatic rotation and pin the screen to a fixed landscape direction.
Permission required to control screen rotation.
When Bike Mode starts, ask to switch Bluetooth on so a helmet intercom or earbuds connect.
Android has no way for an app to switch Bluetooth back off, so Bike Mode leaves it on when you stop.
Stops the screen sleeping mid-ride, so navigation is still there at the next junction.
Set to 30 minutes rather than never, and your own timeout is put back when the ride ends.
Goes to maximum brightness when the light sensor says you are in daylight, for a screen being read in direct sun.
Never at night: it follows the light for the whole ride and gives your brightness back once the sun goes.
Start and stop with the helmet
Bike Mode turns itself on when your helmet connects and off when it disconnects, with no tap at all.
Android asks you to pair Bike Mode with the helmet once, so it may wake the app when the helmet is near. Switch the helmet on first — the system has to find it to complete that step.
Turning Bike Mode off pauses whatever is playing, so nothing keeps going in a helmet you have taken off.
Android pauses whichever app holds the media session; it cannot pause one audio output on its own.
Bike Mode watches for this device when a ride starts and tells you if it did not connect.
Android does not let apps connect an audio device themselves, so Bike Mode can only prompt it and report back.
No paired devices yet. Pair your helmet in Bluetooth settings, or enter its address below.
Allow Bluetooth access to list your paired devices.
Add Bike Mode to Quick Settings for one-tap access while riding.
Some apps enforce their own screen orientation and may ignore the system rotation lock.
Lock the screen to landscape with one tap.
Shown while Bike Mode is holding the screen in landscape.
Your device prevented Bike Rotation Lock from changing the screen orientation.
